name: Things
author: Marius Ghizdavet
description: Things 3 in the Omarchy bar: all seven views (Today, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday, Inbox, Projects, Logbook) plus search, with quick-add, scheduling, moving and checklists — backed by the things3 Cloud CLI. Speaks 10 languages, following the system locale by default.

barWidget.description: The current view's task count in the bar, with a panel to work the list: complete, quick-add, schedule, move, rename and delete.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Auto follows the system locale and falls back to English when it is not one of the translated languages.

schema.label: View the panel opens on
schema.description: Also the view whose count and icon the bar pill shows. Middle-click the pill to cycle.

schema.label: Refresh interval on mains power (seconds)
schema.description: Every refresh is one Things Cloud sync — the cadence used while the laptop runs on mains power, and always on a desktop.

schema.label: Refresh interval on battery (seconds)
schema.description: A sync wakes the radio, so a slower cadence is worth it on battery.

schema.label: Days of Logbook to load
schema.description: How far back the Logbook view reaches. "Done today" is counted from this window.

schema.label: Where quick-add puts a new task
schema.description: An open project always wins over this setting, and a #project written on the line wins over both.

schema.label: Show the count in the bar
schema.description: Turned off, the bar keeps only the view's icon.

schema.label: Show a line of notes under each task
schema.description: A pasted link is shown as its host and path, and opens in your browser.

schema.label: Ask before deleting a task
schema.description: Turned off, the delete action and the x key remove the task immediately.
